angelbot.notification.title: Angelbot
angelbot.debug.bite: [Angelbot] Bite detected (sink speed %s), reacting in %s ticks
angelbot.messages.started: Started. Keep a fishing rod in your hand.
angelbot.messages.addonDisabled: The addon is switched off in the settings.
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.off: Cannot walk: the setting "Walk to the next spot" is switched off.
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.noRadius: Cannot walk: the allowed area radius is 0. Set a radius in the settings.
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.noCenter: Cannot walk: no area center. Stand in the middle and use /angelbot zone set.
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.cannotMove: Cannot walk right now (a screen is open or the player cannot move).
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.noWorld: Cannot walk: the world around you is not loaded.
angelbot.messages.walkBlocked.fewSpots: Cannot walk: you need at least two saved spots (/angelbot spot add).
angelbot.messages.notInGame: You have to be in a world first.
angelbot.messages.noRod: Hold a fishing rod in your main hand or off hand.
angelbot.messages.paused: Paused: a screen is open. Tip: F3+P stops Minecraft from pausing when the window loses focus.
angelbot.messages.rodSwitched: Switched to another rod (%s uses left).
angelbot.messages.noFood: You are hungry, but none of the allowed food was found.
angelbot.messages.walking: The spot is empty. Walking to spot %s of %s.
angelbot.messages.stopped.leftGame: Stopped: you left the world. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.noRod: Stopped: no fishing rod in hand. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.noSpareRod: Stopped: the rod is used up and there is no spare rod. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.noWater: Stopped: the bobber does not land in water. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.noResponse: Stopped: the server does not react to the rod. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.outOfZone: Stopped: you are outside the allowed area. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.spotEmpty: Stopped: the spot is empty and the bot cannot walk to another one. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.allSpotsEmpty: Stopped: all saved spots are empty or resting. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.walkFailed: Stopped: the way to the next spot is blocked or the bot got stuck. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.walkDanger: Stopped walking: damage, water or low health. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.addonDisabled: Stopped: the addon was switched off. Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.stopped.error: Stopped because of an internal error (see latest.log). Bites: %s
angelbot.messages.statusOff: The bot is off. Start it with /angelbot or the toggle key.
angelbot.messages.spot.added: Spot %s saved at %s / %s / %s (with your viewing direction).
angelbot.messages.spot.none: No spots saved yet. Stand where you want to fish, look at the water and use /angelbot spot add.
angelbot.messages.spot.notFound: There is no spot with that number.
angelbot.messages.spot.notOnGround: Stand still on the ground first, then save the spot.
angelbot.messages.spot.notWalkable: Note: the bot cannot stand safely here (slab, stairs, carpet, water, lava or cactus nearby), so it will not walk to this spot.
angelbot.messages.spot.full: The list is full (%s spots). Remove one first.
angelbot.messages.spot.outside: This place is more than %s blocks away from the center of the allowed area.
angelbot.messages.zone.setNoRadius: The area has no radius yet. Set "Allowed area radius" in the addon settings, otherwise there is no limit.
angelbot.messages.zone.cleared: Area center removed. The area is centered on the point where the bot starts.
angelbot.messages.zone.showNone: No fixed center: the area is centered on the point where the bot starts (radius %s blocks, 0 = no limit).
angelbot.messages.config.usage: Usage: /angelbot set <name> <value>, for example /angelbot set walkToNextSpot true
angelbot.messages.config.unknown: There is no setting with that name. /angelbot config lists them.
angelbot.messages.config.invalid: That value does not fit this setting (number in range, true/false or text).
